item.title: Tcl Web Stacks in 2026: NaviServer vs Apache Rivet vs OpenACS Compared
item.description: Most developers write off Tcl as a language that died with the dot-com boom. Then you check the commit log: NaviServer’s repository received a commit on September 15, 2026, Apache Tcl Rivet was pushed on August 30, 2026, and OpenACS core on August 31, 2026. These are not museum pieces on life support — they are small, focused, actively maintained codebases that still serve real deployments, and they solve a problem most modern stacks handle badly: running long-lived, single-process business logic with almost no memory overhead.
